content.text: Eyes open for stories about Tigers-Wings producing masks in a factory. Apparently, they are approaching a significant amount of the staff with a mandate that they have to start working factory shifts at a Caesars factory in Farm Hills making masks if they want to maintain benefits and full time status. Not an optional thing.
Yeah, I know. I got a copy of Granger’s e-mail, I’m just trying to figure the story out. I think it’s newsworthy, the couple employees I talked to seem very on edge about it
There is a mother of young kids being forced into it and she can’t get a babysitter right now
Wow
I wasn’t clear if they were voluntary or non-voluntary
They think they are doing it to furlough people
I heard secondhand that they were told if they took a furlough they won’t have a job when they come back
That’s what I was getting at. It didn’t seem like “weekly furloughs” or what not.... Almost like they figure people are eventually not going to comply or just quit
And then what are the masks for?
The e-mail is vague about “some of these could be donated to local charities”
I would probably just ask them to comment on it and see what the line is. 3 people did quit already over it so it isn’t voluntary
I think they’re trying to make masks to distribute so people come out
Even if they are all donated, that is grandstanding in my mind. Chris and Chris will be all proud of it when they forced people into working factory shifts. One of the shifts starts at 5am.
Yea that could be true also
Why not get the stadium staff that is out of work to do that stuff
I heard they are part of it also maybe
Then you’re putting more people back to work
Ah
They don’t want to pay anyone that isn’t already getting paid though
Yep
[Attachment: Image]
Wow. What happened there?
I don’t know. I wonder if they got pressure from legal
I’m not sure if it’s just marketing
Someone just answered my text. It’s still on but less people and less shifts.
Yea maybe they avoided certain staffs for now
Don’t share that, If possible.
I won’t. I just asked someone what was new with it
I texted a ticket guy to see if they got a similar e-mail
The person I texted is in group sales. She was on at first but was just taken off.
Sounds like most ticket sales types are still included. This person had kids so that may be why she was let off hook now
Ah ok
